chunks: "Death is the expiation for the sin of every believer."

key_terms.الْمَوْتُ: death, the end of worldly life
key_terms.كَفَّارَةُ: expiation; that which removes or covers sin

ai.seo_question: How does death relate to the forgiveness of a believer's sins in hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that death serves as an expiation for the sins of every believer. It highlights a merciful aspect of the believer's passage from this world and connects death with purification.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.358 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Death is the expiation for the sins of every believer."
